Actions.Name: Fixtures: Setup
Actions.Tooltip: Press to read the show from Capture again. The universe and DMX address of each fixture are in this key's inspector panel (addresses re-patched in Capture are picked up automatically).

Actions.Name: Fixtures: Release
Actions.Tooltip: Stops all DMX output: Stream_Terminated is sent on every universe in use.

Actions.Name: Fixtures: Home Selected
Actions.Tooltip: Puts the selected fixture(s) (only) at full home: pan/tilt 50 %, intensity 100 %, additive colours full, the rest 0.

Actions.Name: Fixtures: Status
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the show name, how many fixtures are controllable and whether DMX output is active. Press to read the show again.

Actions.Name: Fixtures: ◀ Page
Actions.Tooltip: Previous attribute page (Position, Intensity, Colour, Beam, Shutters, Gobo/Prism/FX, Other) of the selected fixture for the Attribute dials. The title shows the current page.

Actions.Name: Fixtures: Page ▶
Actions.Tooltip: Next attribute page (Position, Intensity, Colour, Beam, Shutters, Gobo/Prism/FX, Other) of the selected fixture for the Attribute dials. The title shows the current page.

Actions.Name: Fixture: Select
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the fixture(s) selected in Capture (the deck follows Capture's selection). Turn to pick one fixture by hand; Capture's next click overrides it.

Actions.Name: Fixture: Attribute 1
Actions.Tooltip: Shows and drives channel 1 of the current attribute page (◀ Page / Page ▶) of the selected fixture(s): turn ±1 % per tick (16-bit aware), push = home that channel, tap the strip = fine (0.1 %). With several fixtures selected, each one's channel of the same name moves relative to its own value. The first touch starts DMX output for that fixture's universe.

Actions.Name: Fixture: Attribute 2
Actions.Tooltip: Shows and drives channel 2 of the current attribute page (◀ Page / Page ▶) of the selected fixture(s): turn ±1 % per tick (16-bit aware), push = home that channel, tap the strip = fine (0.1 %). With several fixtures selected, each one's channel of the same name moves relative to its own value. The first touch starts DMX output for that fixture's universe.

Actions.Name: Fixture: Pan
Actions.Tooltip: (Fixed dial, kept for hand-placed layouts; the default profile uses Attribute 1–3.) Turn to change Pan of the selected fixture(s) (Fixture: Select) by 1 % per tick, 16-bit aware. Push: home this attribute on the selected fixture(s). Tap the strip: fine (0.1 %). The first touch starts DMX output for that fixture's universe.

Actions.Name: Capture Command
Actions.Tooltip: Fires any Capture menu command (View, Edit, File…). Dims when the command is disabled. (Hidden in v0.3: only kept so keys placed earlier still work.)

Actions.Name: Capture Tab
Actions.Tooltip: Switches Capture to Design, Fixtures, Universes, Media, Snapshots or Library. (Hidden in v0.3: only kept so keys placed earlier still work.)

Actions.Name: Camera Slot
Actions.Tooltip: Recalls Camera Position 1–5. While a Store Modifier key is held, stores it instead. (Hidden in v0.3: only kept so keys placed earlier still work.)

Actions.Name: Show Position
Actions.Tooltip: Recalls a camera position from the open show over OSC, titled with its name in Capture. (Hidden in v0.3: only kept so keys placed earlier still work.)

Actions.Name: View Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to adjust a Capture view setting over OSC. Push or touch: fine mode. Long touch: reset. (Hidden in v0.3: only kept so keys placed earlier still work.)

Actions.Name: View Toggle
Actions.Tooltip: Toggles Auto Exposure or Laser Flicker Effect over OSC. (Hidden in v0.3: only kept so keys placed earlier still work.)

Description: An interface to Capture: keys fire Capture's own menu commands and tabs and recall camera positions; dials adjust view settings over OSC. Every action is a straight command, and a ready-made Stream Deck+ profile organises them in folders.
